_comment: People the question generator knows. Everyone here can be a wrong answer;
everyone with five clues is also the subject of a who-am-I and a detective case.
sex, era and roles decide who is a plausible wrong answer for whom, so get
them right before worrying about anything else. era is one of beginnings,
patriarchs, exodus, judges, kingdom, prophets, exile, gospels, church.
difficulty is how well known the person is: 1 is a household name.
Clues are written in the first person, vaguest first. A clue must never
contain the person's name or any name in accept — the check refuses it.
Each rests on a reference, and the check warns when that reference's chapter
never names the person, which usually means the reference is wrong.
Keep clues factual: what the text says happened, not what it means.
